/* @cfg msaa = 1 */

/* @cfg point_attenuation = 1 */
/* @cfg post_fx_scope = GLR_POST_FX_SCOPE_OFF */
/* @cfg post_fx_effect = GLR_POST_FX_EFFECT_CHROMATIC_ABERRATION */
/* @cfg auto_time = 1 */
/* @cfg replay = 0 */
/* @cfg replay_mode = 1 */
/* @cfg replay_expand = 1 */
/* @cfg grid = GRID_THEME_OFF */
/* @cfg grid_major = GRID_MAJOR_1 */
/* @cfg grid_extent = GRID_EXTENT_FAR */
/* @cfg grid_brightness = GRID_BRIGHTNESS_NORMAL */
/* @cfg axes = AXES_THEME_OFF */
/* @cfg backdrop = RENDER3D_BACKDROP_STARS */
/* @cfg light_theme = LIGHT_THEME_DEFAULT */
/* @cfg light_indicators = 0 */
/* @cfg view_mode = RENDER3D_VIEW_3D */
/* @cfg projection = PROJ_PERSPECTIVE */
/* @cfg camera_rotate = 0 */
/* @cfg wireframe = WIREFRAME_OFF */
/* @cfg winding = 0 */
/* @cfg depth_view = 0 */
/* @cfg auto_normals = 0 */
/* @cfg label_highlight_scope = OVERLAY_SCOPE_FIRST_INSTANCE */
/* @cfg vertex_labels = 0 */
/* @cfg vertex_points = 0 */
/* @cfg vertex_outlines = 0 */
/* @cfg vertex_outline_style = VERTEX_OUTLINE_STYLE_DEFAULT */
/* @cfg normal_vectors = 0 */
/* @cfg polygon_highlight = 1 */
/* @cfg transform_guides = 0 */
/* @cfg variable_panel = 0 */
/* @cfg compute_profile = 0 */
/* @cfg memory_profile = 0 */
/* @cfg code_panel = 1 */

/* @cfg paren_scope = 1 */

--- header_pre ---
#define j0 _j0
#define j1 _j1
#define jn _jn
#define y0 _y0
#define y1 _y1
#define yn _yn
#define gamma _gamma
#define lgamma _lgamma
#define tgamma _tgamma
#include <stddef.h>
#if defined(__APPLE__)
#include <OpenGL/gl.h>
#include <OpenGL/glu.h>
#include <GLUT/glut.h>
#else
#define GL_GLEXT_PROTOTYPES
#include <GL/gl.h>
#include <GL/glext.h>
#include <GL/glu.h>
#include <GL/freeglut.h>
#endif
#include <math.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#undef j0
#undef j1
#undef jn
#undef y0
#undef y1
#undef yn
#undef gamma
#undef lgamma
#undef tgamma

#ifndef M_PI
#define M_PI 3.14159265358979323846
#endif

static float g_angle = 0.0f;
static int   g_rotating = 0;

--- display_header ---
void display(void) {
  glLoadIdentity();
  glPushAttrib(GL_ALL_ATTRIB_BITS);
--- lights_pre_camera ---
--- camera ---
  glTranslatef(0.0000f, 0.0000f, -5.5000f);
  glRotatef(18.0000f, 1.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f);
  glRotatef(32.0000f, 0.0f, 1.0f, 0.0f);
  glTranslatef(-0.0000f, -0.0000f, -0.0000f);
--- header_post ---
--- render_state ---
  glEnable(GL_MULTISAMPLE);
  glDisable(GL_LINE_SMOOTH);
  float A[16], B[16], C[16];
--- source ---
  static float exhaustCount = 140; // plasma particles per frame
  static float debrisCount = 240; // gentle drifting micro-debris
  static float rockCount = 32; // medium tumbling chunks
  static float engineZ = 4; // rear plane where the nozzles sit
  static float exhaustSpeed = 3.4; // how fast plasma streams past the camera
  static float driftSpeed = 2.2; // apparent forward speed of the star field
  static float hullFlat = 0.6; // vertical squash -> blade-like cross section
  static float a0, a1, am; // hull facet angles
  static float nz0, nz1; // hull facet z-normal (taper tilt)
  static float px, py, pz; // generic particle position
  static float age, frac, life, nozzle;
  static float mz, mr; // habitat module placement
  static float bigZ, bigX, bigY; // the occasional large asteroid

  // ===== Mothership Exodus =====
  // Earth's last survivors ride a Homeworld-scale mothership toward a distant,
  // hopeful star. The ship holds station in frame while space streams past it:
  // engine plasma, gentle debris, the rare wandering asteroid. Cool somber hull,
  // warm habitat windows (10,000 souls aboard), warm engines and destination sun.
  // The camera follows from close behind and a little to the left, swaying gently
  // so the scene never sits still. Endless: every field wraps or loops on t.

  // --- tunables ---

  // --- scratch (shared across the funcs + loops below) ---

  // A faceted tapered hull ring-to-ring, one flat normal per face -> low-poly look.
  // slope tilts the normal along z so the taper still catches the light.
  hullTube(z0, r0, z1, r1, sides, cr, cg, cb) {
    glColor3f(cr, cg, cb);
    nz0 = (r0 - r1) / (z1 - z0);
    for(s, 0, sides) {
      a0 = s*TAU/sides;
      a1 = (s + 1)*TAU/sides;
      am = (s + 0.5)*TAU/sides;
      glBegin(GL_QUADS);
        glNormal3f(cos(am), sin(am), nz0);
        glVertex3f(r0*cos(a0), r0*sin(a0), z0);
        glVertex3f(r0*cos(a1), r0*sin(a1), z0);
        glVertex3f(r1*cos(a1), r1*sin(a1), z1);
        glVertex3f(r1*cos(a0), r1*sin(a0), z1);
      glEnd();
    }
  }

  // A flat angular plate (dorsal spine / keel fin), two triangles, one normal.
  plate(x0, y0, z0, x1, y1, z1, x2, y2, z2, cr, cg, cb) {
    glColor3f(cr, cg, cb);
    glBegin(GL_TRIANGLES);
      glNormal3f(0, 1, 0);
      glVertex3f(x0, y0, z0);
      glVertex3f(x1, y1, z1);
      glVertex3f(x2, y2, z2);
    glEnd();
  }

  // An axis-aligned plating box centered at (bx,by,bz) with half-extents s*.
  box(bx, by, bz, sx, sy, sz, cr, cg, cb) {
    glColor3f(cr, cg, cb);
    glPushMatrix();
      glTranslatef(bx, by, bz);
      glScalef(sx, sy, sz);
      glutSolidCube(1);
    glPopMatrix();
  }

  // A stepped bridge / command tower with a comm mast, riding the forward spine.
  bridge() {
    box(0.0, 1.05, -4.7, 0.5, 0.5, 1.5, 0.24, 0.28, 0.36);
    box(0.0, 1.5, -4.7, 0.34, 0.45, 0.9, 0.27, 0.31, 0.4);
    box(0.0, 1.85, -4.9, 0.2, 0.34, 0.34, 0.22, 0.25, 0.32);
    box(0.0, 2.25, -4.9, 0.05, 0.5, 0.05, 0.3, 0.34, 0.4);
    // secondary sensor block further aft
    box(0.0, 0.95, -1.2, 0.42, 0.45, 0.7, 0.24, 0.28, 0.36);
  }

  // The whole ship, built along -Z (nose) to +Z (engines), squashed flat in Y.
  mothership() {
    glPushMatrix();
      glScalef(1.0, hullFlat, 1.0);

      // prow -> forebody -> broad main hull -> engine housing, cool steel blues
      hullTube(-9.0, 0.12, -6.6, 0.85, 8, 0.30, 0.35, 0.44);
      hullTube(-6.6, 0.85, -3.0, 1.30, 8, 0.27, 0.32, 0.42);
      hullTube(-3.0, 1.30, 2.0, 1.72, 10, 0.30, 0.35, 0.45);
      hullTube(2.0, 1.72, 3.6, 2.05, 10, 0.22, 0.26, 0.34);
      // rear cap ring closing the engine housing
      hullTube(3.6, 2.05, 4.0, 1.55, 10, 0.18, 0.21, 0.28);
    glPopMatrix();

    // Dorsal spine: a tall angular blade riding the top of the hull.
    plate(0.0, 0.9, -5.8, 0.0, 2.4, -1.6, 0.0, 0.85, 2.6, 0.34, 0.40, 0.5);
    plate(0.0, 0.85, 2.6, 0.0, 2.4, -1.6, 0.0, 0.75, 3.4, 0.30, 0.36, 0.46);
    // Ventral keel fin, shorter, darker.
    plate(0.0, -0.85, -4.4, 0.0, -1.7, 0.2, 0.0, -0.8, 2.4, 0.2, 0.24, 0.32);

    // Two swept side wings (blade planes off the main hull).
    plate(1.6, 0.0, -1.4, 3.5, 0.1, 1.2, 1.7, 0.0, 2.4, 0.28, 0.33, 0.42);
    plate(-1.6, 0.0, -1.4, -3.5, 0.1, 1.2, -1.7, 0.0, 2.4, 0.28, 0.33, 0.42);

    // Bridge / command tower and forward sensor block.
    bridge();

    // Habitat module blisters: two banked rows of boxes down each flank -- the
    // decks where the ten thousand live. Cheap (each box is one GLUT solid).
    for(m, 0, 13) {
      mz = -3.2 + 0.42*m;
      mr = 1.34 + 0.06*(mz + 3.0) + 0.16;
      box(mr, 0.30, mz, 0.16, 0.22, 0.16, 0.26, 0.30, 0.38);
      box(mr, -0.28, mz, 0.16, 0.2, 0.16, 0.22, 0.25, 0.32);
      box(-mr, 0.30, mz, 0.16, 0.22, 0.16, 0.26, 0.30, 0.38);
      box(-mr, -0.28, mz, 0.16, 0.2, 0.16, 0.22, 0.25, 0.32);
    }

    // Engine-housing collar ring + four vernier thruster pods around the rim.
    hullTube(2.3, 1.86, 2.55, 1.9, 12, 0.16, 0.19, 0.25);
    for(v, 0, 4) {
      box(1.7*cos(v*TAU/4), 1.7*sin(v*TAU/4)*0.6, 3.2, 0.2, 0.2, 0.34, 0.18, 0.2, 0.26);
    }
  }

  // A dark flared engine bell: wide rim at nz (facing the camera, +Z) tapering
  // into a narrow throat recessed into the hull. Reuses the faceted hull tube.
  thruster(nx, ny, nz, r) {
    glPushMatrix();
      glTranslatef(nx, ny, nz);
      hullTube(0.0, r, -0.9, 0.4*r, 8, 0.12, 0.13, 0.16);
      hullTube(-0.9, 0.4*r, -1.3, 0.22*r, 8, 0.09, 0.10, 0.12);
    glPopMatrix();
  }

  // A low-poly lumpy asteroid at the origin, size s, faceted by flat shading.
  rock(s) {
    glPushMatrix();
      glScalef(s*1.0, s*0.72, s*0.86);
      glutSolidSphere(1, 10, 7);
    glPopMatrix();
  }

  // A soft additive glow disc facing roughly toward the camera (XY plane).
  glow(cx, cy, cz, rad, cr, cg, cb, a) {
    glBegin(GL_TRIANGLE_FAN);
      glColor4f(cr, cg, cb, a);
      glVertex3f(cx, cy, cz);
      glColor4f(cr, cg, cb, 0.0);
      for(s, 0, 25) {
        glVertex3f(cx + rad*cos(s*TAU/24), cy + rad*sin(s*TAU/24), cz);
      }
    glEnd();
  }
  // camera
  glTranslatef(-1, -0.15, -9.4);
  glRotatef(6, 1, 0, 0);
  glRotatef(-13, 0, 1, 0);
  glTranslatef(0, 0, 0);

  // ================= scene =================
  glClearColor(0.02, 0.03, 0.06, 1);
  glEnable(GL_DEPTH_TEST);
  glEnable(GL_NORMALIZE);
  glShadeModel(GL_SMOOTH);

  // Gentle camera sway (~2-4 deg): the ship holds frame, the view breathes.
  glRotatef(2.6*sin(0.23*t), 0, 1, 0);
  glRotatef(1.9*sin(0.17*t + 1.0), 1, 0, 0);
  glRotatef(1.1*sin(0.31*t + 2.0), 0, 0, 1);

  // --- Distant destination star: warm gold core + layered corona (additive) ---
  glDisable(GL_LIGHTING);
  glEnable(GL_BLEND);
  glBlendFunc(GL_SRC_ALPHA, GL_ONE);
  glDepthMask(GL_FALSE);
  glow(-9.0, 5.2, -34.0, 6.0, 1.0, 0.72, 0.36, 0.16);
  glow(-9.0, 5.2, -34.0, 3.2, 1.0, 0.80, 0.46, 0.28);
  glow(-9.0, 5.2, -34.0, 1.5, 1.0, 0.90, 0.66, 0.5);
  glDepthMask(GL_TRUE);
  glColor3f(1, 0.94, 0.78);
  glPushMatrix();
    glTranslatef(-9, 5.2, -34);
    glutSolidSphere(0.9, 16, 12);
  glPopMatrix();
  glDisable(GL_BLEND);

  // --- Gentle micro-debris: a fine field streaming past toward the camera ---
  glEnable(GL_BLEND);
  glBlendFunc(GL_SRC_ALPHA, GL_ONE_MINUS_SRC_ALPHA);
  glPointSize(2);
  glBegin(GL_POINTS);
    for(d, 0, debrisCount) {
      px = 20.0*rand2(d, 1);
      py = 11.0*rand2(d, 2);
      pz = rem(30.0*rand(d, 3) + t*driftSpeed, 44.0) - 30.0;
      frac = 0.4 + 0.6*rand(d, 4);
      glColor4f(0.55*frac, 0.6*frac, 0.72*frac, 0.5*frac);
      glVertex3f(px, py, pz);
    }
  glEnd();
  glDisable(GL_BLEND);

  // --- Lit debris + the occasional large asteroid ---
  glEnable(GL_LIGHTING);
  glEnable(GL_LIGHT0);
  glEnable(GL_LIGHT1);
  glEnable(GL_COLOR_MATERIAL);

  glColor3f(0.3, 0.28, 0.26);
  for(k, 0, rockCount) {
    px = 13.0*rand2(k, 5);
    py = 7.0*rand2(k, 6);
    pz = rem(34.0*rand(k, 7) + t*driftSpeed, 48.0) - 32.0;
    glPushMatrix();
      glTranslatef(px, py, pz);
      glRotatef(40.0*t*rand2(k, 8) + 360.0*rand(k, 9), rand2(k, 10), 1.0, rand2(k, 11));
      rock(0.25 + 0.4*rand(k, 12));
    glPopMatrix();
  }

  // The wandering big asteroid: holds off to one side with clearance, drifting
  // through depth on a long period so it only sweeps through frame occasionally.
  bigZ = rem(t*0.9 + 20.0, 104.0) - 46.0;
  bigX = -7.5 + 1.6*sin(0.05*t);
  bigY = 2.2 + 1.0*sin(0.037*t);
  glColor3f(0.34, 0.3, 0.27);
  glPushMatrix();
    glTranslatef(bigX, bigY, bigZ);
    glRotatef(9.0*t, 0.3, 1.0, 0.2);
    rock(2.2);
  glPopMatrix();

  // --- The mothership + engine bells (lit) ---
  glPushMatrix();
    glTranslatef(0.0, 0.12*sin(0.4*t), 0.0); // faint idle bob
    mothership();
    thruster(0.0, -0.1, engineZ, 0.62);
    thruster(0.92, -0.18, engineZ - 0.05, 0.5);
    thruster(-0.92, -0.18, engineZ - 0.05, 0.5);
  glPopMatrix();

  // Everything from here glows: lighting off, additive, no depth writes.
  glDisable(GL_LIGHTING);
  glEnable(GL_BLEND);
  glBlendFunc(GL_SRC_ALPHA, GL_ONE);

  // --- Habitat windows: warm rows of light along the flanks (10,000 souls) ---
  // px tracks the widening hull profile (+ a hair) so the lights sit on the skin.
  glPointSize(3);
  glBegin(GL_POINTS);
    for(w, 0, 42) {
      pz = -3.4 + 0.14*w;
      px = 1.28 + 0.08*(pz + 3.0) + 0.05;
      frac = 0.6 + 0.4*sin(11.0*w + 2.0*t + 6.0*rand(w, 1));
      glColor4f(1.0*frac, 0.82*frac, 0.5*frac, 1.0*frac);
      glVertex3f(px, 0.28, pz);
      glVertex3f(px, -0.28, pz);
      glVertex3f(-px, 0.28, pz);
      glVertex3f(-px, -0.28, pz);
      glVertex3f(px, 0.02, pz);
      glVertex3f(-px, 0.02, pz);
    }
  glEnd();

  // --- Navigation running lights: port red, starboard green, bridge strobe ---
  // The small competent signs of a crew that came prepared for the long haul.
  glPointSize(5);
  glBegin(GL_POINTS);
    glColor4f(1, 0.2, 0.18, 0.9);
    glVertex3f(-3.5, 0.1, 1.2);
    glColor4f(0.2, 1, 0.3, 0.9);
    glVertex3f(3.5, 0.1, 1.2);
    glColor4f(0.8, 0.9, 1.0, 0.5 + 0.5*sin(6.0*t));
    glVertex3f(0, 2.55, -4.9);
  glEnd();
  glow(-3.5, 0.1, 1.2, 0.28, 1.0, 0.2, 0.18, 0.42);
  glow(3.5, 0.1, 1.2, 0.28, 0.2, 1.0, 0.3, 0.42);

  // --- Engines: warm additive plasma cores glowing inside each bell ---
  glDepthMask(GL_FALSE);
  glow(0.0, -0.1, engineZ - 0.2, 0.55, 1.0, 0.52, 0.16, 0.85);
  glow(0.92, -0.18, engineZ - 0.25, 0.42, 1.0, 0.52, 0.16, 0.8);
  glow(-0.92, -0.18, engineZ - 0.25, 0.42, 1.0, 0.52, 0.16, 0.8);
  glPointSize(7);
  glBegin(GL_POINTS);
    glColor4f(1, 0.85, 0.6, 0.95);
    glVertex3f(0.0, -0.1, engineZ - 0.2);
    glVertex3f(0.92, -0.18, engineZ - 0.25);
    glVertex3f(-0.92, -0.18, engineZ - 0.25);
  glEnd();

  // Plasma exhaust: three streams flowing +Z past the camera, fading as they go.
  glPointSize(6);
  glBegin(GL_POINTS);
    for(p, 0, exhaustCount) {
      nozzle = fmod(p, 3);
      life = 1.5;
      age = rem(t*1.3 + 0.9*rand(p, 1), life);
      frac = age/life;
      px = (nozzle - 1.0)*0.9 + 0.4*rand2(p, 2)*frac;
      py = -0.12 + 0.4*rand2(p, 3)*frac;
      pz = engineZ + 0.2 + age*exhaustSpeed;
      glColor4f(1.0, 0.62 - 0.42*frac, 0.18, (1.0 - frac)*0.85);
      glVertex3f(px, py, pz);
    }
  glEnd();

  // restore shared GL state
  glDepthMask(GL_TRUE);
  glDisable(GL_BLEND);
  glEnable(GL_LIGHTING);
